'''Tobias Sun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] at the [[Hidden Temple]] who kept [[Deliah Blue]] and [[Jariah Syn]] company while [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Shado Vao]] met with the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]]. While waiting, Tobias and Deliah decided to have fun fixing and riding a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] that Sun had been trying to get operational for some time.<ref name="Legacy 25" /> During the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]], Sun led [[Twin Suns Squadron]].<ref name="LW 5" />
